<!-- pr-reviewer: 8460431c74b91223b19e7b1cf1e51de2eb77231c -->
**Needs changes before merge** (small: header wording and the closing keyword).

## What looks good
- Clean-room reading holds: the script's header and the decision file name one public source (Sodick 1998 operation manual, Mark 21) plus RS-274; every emitted word (G20/G21, G90, G54-G59, G00/G01/G02/G03, G40, I J, C###, T91/T90, M00/M01/M02) is in the decision table with its place in the manual. Nothing in the script or tests copies the sample program on #617 or another CAM's post.
- Every program opens with "NOT VERIFIED ON A CONTROL - CHECK BEFORE CUTTING" (script onOpen, golden lines 1-6). Taper (`WireTaper`), 4-axis, U/V lean, posed move, Z change, rotary, rapid while threaded, tool change, rpm, canned cycle, arc as first cut, bad condition id, G54-G59 missing are each refused by name.
- Coordinates always carry a decimal point (an unpointed value would be read in the control's smallest unit); no timestamps; no new dependency; no snapshot or existing golden changed; the registry keeps the generic wire post as default.

## Results (locally, merged with main at df90b031f, `-j 4`; the runner was busy with another PR run)
- `camcraft-post --test script_sodick_wire`: 11 passed
- `camcraft-app --test sodick_wire_post`: 8 passed; `--test wire_post`: 8 passed; `--test conformance`: 7 passed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean
- Not run: the rest of the app suites and camcraft-ui (the diff touches no UI). I did not remove the script to show the new tests fail; the registry and golden tests read the script by name, so they cannot pass without it.

## Requested before merge
1. `assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps` onOpen / `startCut` (the `G00 X Y`, `T91`, `C###` run before `G40`): `G40` is written only on the first cut, so the `G00` to the start hole and the threading run under whatever wire offset the control still holds from an earlier program. The PR lists `G40` as unconfirmed but the header does not say it. Either write `G40` with the first `G00` (only if the manual shows it) or add a header line, e.g. "WIRE OFFSET (G41 G42) MUST BE CANCELLED AT THE CONTROL BEFORE START", and update the goldens (do not hand-edit; regenerate with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1` and read the diff).
2. Same place: the condition is a bare `C###` word with no condition table in the file. If the control has no such condition or keeps the previous one, the cut runs on conditions nobody chose. Add a header line naming it, e.g. "CONDITION C110 MUST EXIST IN THE CONTROL - CHECK ITS VALUES", built from the operation's condition id per section.
3. Commit/PR body ends `Fixes #617`. The issue's machine is an AQ600L (LN control) and the post is written from the Mark 21 manual and unverified, with #1500 (confirm LN format) open. Use `Refs #617` so the issue stays open until a machine owner confirms, or say in the PR that the maintainer accepts closing on an unverified slice. I recommend `Refs`.

## Notes (not blocking)
- Judged safe to ship as stated, given the header: no G92/G29 (header says the work offset is set at the control; a G54-G59 is required); no tank/flushing words (header says so; a dry cut is a process risk the operator is told about); no `%` / program number / `M30` (manual examples end `M02`); `M02` after `T90`.
- The source was read through a summarising fetch, not page by page; one more confirmation of the word list by someone with the manual in hand would be worth a line in #1500.
- Files stay under ~400 lines except the script (exempt).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 4276e97e8473cc2cabe3defddb8689ecff91d0ef -->
**Re-review at 4276e97: Ready for the maintainer to merge, with one note for the merger (issue 617 must stay open).**

The three requests from the review of 8460431c7 are addressed.

## Earlier requests, checked at this head
1. **G40 before any motion: done.** `startCut` in `assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps` (about line 203) now writes `G40 G00 X.. Y..`. It is the only path that runs before a section's first cut. `onRapid` writes nothing, a rapid while threaded is refused, and `onLinear` and `onCircular` write no G40 any more. `startCut` runs once per unthreaded section, so every re-thread starts with the cancel. The golden and `the_punch_contour_posts_its_sodick_golden_through_the_gate` pin `G40 G00 X-30. Y0.`, exactly one G40 in the program, and that it comes before T91 and the first G01. The inch test pins it too. The cancel in the same block as G00 is justified by RS-274 modal groups; this is an unconfirmed reading (see below).
2. **C condition note: done.** The header now carries "EACH C CONDITION NAMED BELOW MUST EXIST IN THE CONTROL CONDITION TABLE BEFORE START". Each section carries "CONDITION C110 MUST EXIST ... CHECK ITS VALUES" before its first motion. The test checks the order of both lines.
3. **Issue 617 must not close.** The PR body and the new commit say `Refs`. The first commit (`feat(post): Sodick wire EDM post...`) still carries a closing keyword, so GitHub may close 617 when this merges. **The merger must reopen 617 (or keep it open) after merging.** I did not change the commit.

## Golden change
Only `wire_slug_punch.nc` differs from the previous head. It gains the header condition line, the section condition line, and `G40` moved from `G01 X-20.165` to the `G00` positioning line. All three follow the requests above. The change is right: no motion now precedes the offset cancel. I did not regenerate any golden. The arc-first refusal text changed because its reason (G40 rides a straight move) no longer applies. The refusal itself is unchanged, and an arc start is still not shown in the source manual.

## What looks good
- Refusals are by name; the program header says it is not verified on a control.
- The post's text comes from the 1998 Sodick manual, RS-274 / ISO 6983 and the project's `wire-iso.cps`. I saw no vendor post text. This is read from the body and diff; I did not audit the manual.
- No new dependency. The change is confined to `assets/posts/`, post and app tests, the registry entry and the decision file.

## Results merged with main
On the self-hosted runner: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43499211470 (head 4276e97 trial-merged with main 4ed03a48), conclusion success.
- Quick gate: post suites ok, app suites ok, 0 failed (14.5 min wall).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not run locally. The diff has no `cfg(windows)` or per-OS pinned values.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Not exercised / notes (not blocking)
- No Sodick control or simulator ran this output. Every item under "Unconfirmed" in the PR body still needs a check at the machine, in particular `G40` beside `G00` with no offset active, and the LN1W / LN2W controls reading these Mark 21 words.
- I did not see a test with two sections in one program. The code re-threads through `startCut`, so each section should start with its own G40, but a pinning test would be good follow-up work.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
